body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 3 units in a straight line. On success, deal 2 Bludgeoning Damage and push the target 1 unit.

surges.html: Knock the target Prone if it ends beside an obstacle.

rider.title: Combo - Blitz
rider.html: After a hit, spend 1 Combo to enter Avalanche Stance: while advancing toward an enemy, the first difficult space you enter each turn costs no extra Movement.
